# Fields of PoolPlan, StepShape and Transfer that no price depends on yet (design SUB-11).
# One line each: Type.Field, then why. The list may only shrink: TestEveryPlanFieldIsPricedOrListed
# fails on a field not listed here and on a listed field that no longer exists. Delete a line in
# the change that prices the field, with the test that moves a price when the field changes.
# Never add a line to admit a new field: a new field is priced in the change that adds it.
#
# WHY EVERY LINE IS HERE. The boundary types are added to contracts in M2 (design 3.3), and the
# cost model still prices from kernel.Batch and its own resolution. The equivalence test that
# prices an emitted plan and compares it with the old path lives in inference-sim, which imports
# both; the cost model reads a plan when that test passes. Until then the types are validated,
# serialised and accounted for (plan.Memory, plan.Validate) and priced by nothing.
